name: Storista
summary: Shopify app that turns TikTok, Reels and UGC clips into shoppable video widgets (carousels, stories, grids and spotlights), with auto-sync from TikTok and Instagram.
best_for: Shopify stores that already produce TikTok or Reels content and want it on the storefront as shoppable video, with the free tier's unlimited views making it cheap to test whether social video converts on your product pages at all
skip_if: you have no UGC or short-form pipeline to feed it (the widget displays content, it does not create any) or you want automatic product-to-video tagging without paying $49 a month for it
honest_knock:
The first thing to know is how much this ladder has moved. When we first read it on 23 August 2026 the free plan stopped at 10 videos, a $15 Basic plan stopped at 50, and storista.io sold a different product altogether, an AI UGC video generator priced per render. Read again on 10 October 2026, the Shopify listing and storista.io sell the same widget, the free plan lists unlimited videos, and the paid tiers are called Starter, Growth and Scale. As of 24 November 2026, Storista's pricing FAQ also says the Free plan includes unlimited videos.

Second, read the headline against the pricing table. AI Smart Tagging is the feature the app leads its pitch with, and it appears on Growth at $49 and above. On Free and Starter you tag products to videos yourself.

Third, the rating deserves its detail. On 10 October 2026 it was 4.9 from 54 reviews: 51 five-star, two four-star and one one-star. In August the same listing showed 5.0 from 49, which was a rounding rather than a perfect record, and that is worth checking on any app whose average sits on or near the ceiling.

Finally, the data access. When we read it in August 2026 the listing stated the app views customer device and activity data and can view and edit customers, products, store analytics, custom data and Shopify admin. That is a wide grant for a widget that displays video, and it belongs in your processing register whatever you decide about the product.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, removing Storista's branding and adding Instagram/TikTok auto-sync, GEO/SEO optimisation and multiple products per video, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on apps.shopify.com/storista-stories, listed as “Storista Shoppable Videos UGC”, and on storista.io/pricing) Four tiers. Free lists unlimited videos and views, Shop app integration and manual import from Instagram and TikTok, and keeps Storista branding on the widget; Storista's pricing FAQ also says the Free plan includes unlimited videos. Starter is $15 a month and adds GEO/SEO optimisation, multiple products per video, manual videos on product pages, removal of the Storista branding, auto-sync from Instagram and TikTok and manual caption uploads. Growth is $49 a month and adds AI Smart Tagging, advanced analytics, auto captions in 40 languages, A/B tests and smart videos on product pages. Scale is $199 a month for Shopify Plus stores and adds VIP support, multiple stores and custom widgets. Every paid tier carries a 14-day free trial, and storista.io says you are not charged if you cancel during it. On annual billing, Starter is $12 a month, Growth is $39, and Scale is $159. Charges are in USD. When we first read the listing on 23 August 2026 the tiers were called Basic and Business, Free stopped at 10 videos and Basic at 50, and storista.io sold a different product, AI-generated UGC video priced per render; read on 10 October 2026, storista.io sells this same widget. Developer Storista LLC, Sheridan, Wyoming; the app launched on 19 February 2021 and had 54 reviews at a 4.9 average on 10 October 2026.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Storista on a Shopify development store only in part: the install, the empty dashboard on the free plan, the onboarding with its three sources (Instagram, TikTok, Upload files), the plan page with Starter at $15, Growth at $49 and Scale at $199, and the Starter approval screen (it asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence, so nothing was approved). The core action, importing a video and placing a widget, was not achieved: the upload field sits in a cross-origin iframe that the test tool cannot reach, and the Instagram and TikTok route needs a username and a rights tick box that was not ticked. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Nothing was paid and nothing was saved in the theme. Install: the app was installed through the install form in our own tab at 16:55; the dialog Install app asked for access to customer data, staff data and store data, and the app was installed at 16:56. The App Store name is Storista Shoppable Videos UGC; in the admin the app is called Storista (by Storista LLC). The admin was in English. After the install the app opened straight on Welcome to Storista with three steps (Choose source, Import and Tag, Embed); no payment and no account on the vendor site were needed, and the dashboard said You're on Free. Core action, importing a video and placing a widget: this was NOT achieved and no result was measured. The onboarding asks Where should we get your videos from? with the choices Instagram, TikTok and Upload files. Instagram and TikTok ask for a username and a tick box with the text that you have all rights and permissions to import content from that account; the tick box was not ticked because we have no account of our own to import from. Upload files says it accepts .mp4 and .mov, maximum 10 videos. The app runs in a cross-origin iframe on the vendor domain, and the file upload tool of the tester could not reach the file field there. That is a limit of the test tool and not a fault of the app. The Media Library was empty (Click Import content to add content) and Recent widgets said You don't have any widgets yet. Plans: the page Select plan shows Starter $15 per month, Growth $49 per month (Most popular) and Scale $199 per month, each with a Start 14-day free trial button and the text cancel anytime, and a switch Pay annually (Save 20%); the yearly amounts were not looked at. Free is $0 with Unlimited videos, Unlimited views, manual import from Instagram and TikTok, manual product videos, one product per video, Shop app integration and Storista branding. Starter adds auto-sync, multiple products per video, GEO/SEO optimization, Shop app integration, import by URL, upload files up to 1GB, manual captions uploads and removal of the branding. Growth adds AI Smart Product Tagging, smart videos to PDP, advanced analytics, Auto captions in 60 languages and A/B tests. Scale adds API and webhooks, multiple stores support and VIP support. Differences with the dossier: the dossier says Growth has auto captions in 40 languages, and the plan page of the app says Auto captions 60 languages; the dossier notes that the vendor FAQ says the free plan covers 10 videos while the plan list says unlimited videos, and the onboarding says maximum 10 videos for one upload, so which statement governs was not settled because no video was uploaded. Checkout: Start 14-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription for the plan Starter: $15,00 USD every 30 days, a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a Subtotal of $15,00 plus any applicable taxes, a Total of $15,00 due 1 Dec, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method was needed, so the charge was not approved and it was cancelled. Nothing was billed and no card was entered. The Growth and Scale approval screens were not opened. Cancelling: no subscription was started, so nothing could be cancelled. The way to stop is to uninstall: Settings, Apps, Storista, Uninstall opens Uninstall Storista? with the text that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, a request to delete customer data within 48 hours and a required reason (Testing multiple apps). Not tested: a video import, a widget in the theme editor, the Shop app, auto-sync, AI tagging, the unlimited videos claim on Free, auto captions in any language, and any paid plan. No theme change was made or saved and no widget or page was created. Clean up: the app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps and is gone from the Installed list; no theme sections or pages were made by the app; no plan was approved and nothing was billed. Our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes (16:55 and 16:56) can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The core action could not be reached with our tools, the onboarding says maximum 10 videos for an upload while the free plan lists unlimited videos, the plan page says Auto captions 60 languages where the dossier says 40, the Starter approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence, and the Instagram and TikTok sources need a username and a rights tick box before anything is imported.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Storista on a Shopify development store only in part: the install, the empty dashboard on the free plan, the onboarding with its three sources (Instagram, TikTok, Upload files), the plan page with Starter at $15, Growth at $49 and Scale at $199, and the Starter approval screen (it asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence, so nothing was approved). The core action, importing a video and placing a widget, was not achieved: the upload field sits in a cross-origin iframe that the test tool cannot reach, and the Instagram and TikTok route needs a username and a rights tick box that was not ticked. The app was uninstalled afterwards. Nothing was paid and nothing was saved in the theme. Install: the app was installed through the install form in our own tab at 16:55; the dialog Install app asked for access to customer data, staff data and store data, and the app was installed at 16:56. The App Store name is Storista Shoppable Videos UGC; in the admin the app is called Storista (by Storista LLC). The admin was in English. After the install the app opened straight on Welcome to Storista with three steps (Choose source, Import and Tag, Embed); no payment and no account on the vendor site were needed, and the dashboard said You're on Free. Core action, importing a video and placing a widget: this was NOT achieved and no result was measured. The onboarding asks Where should we get your videos from? with the choices Instagram, TikTok and Upload files. Instagram and TikTok ask for a username and a tick box with the text that you have all rights and permissions to import content from that account; the tick box was not ticked because we have no account of our own to import from. Upload files says it accepts .mp4 and .mov, maximum 10 videos. The app runs in a cross-origin iframe on the vendor domain, and the file upload tool of the tester could not reach the file field there. That is a limit of the test tool and not a fault of the app. The Media Library was empty (Click Import content to add content) and Recent widgets said You don't have any widgets yet. Plans: the page Select plan shows Starter $15 per month, Growth $49 per month (Most popular) and Scale $199 per month, each with a Start 14-day free trial button and the text cancel anytime, and a switch Pay annually (Save 20%); the yearly amounts were not looked at. Free is $0 with Unlimited videos, Unlimited views, manual import from Instagram and TikTok, manual product videos, one product per video, Shop app integration and Storista branding. Starter adds auto-sync, multiple products per video, GEO/SEO optimization, Shop app integration, import by URL, upload files up to 1GB, manual captions uploads and removal of the branding. Growth adds AI Smart Product Tagging, smart videos to PDP, advanced analytics, Auto captions in 60 languages and A/B tests. Scale adds API and webhooks, multiple stores support and VIP support. Differences with the dossier: the dossier says Growth has auto captions in 40 languages, and the plan page of the app says Auto captions 60 languages; the dossier notes that the vendor FAQ says the free plan covers 10 videos while the plan list says unlimited videos, and the onboarding says maximum 10 videos for one upload, so which statement governs was not settled because no video was uploaded. Checkout: Start 14-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify screen Approve subscription for the plan Starter: $15,00 USD every 30 days, a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a Subtotal of $15,00 plus any applicable taxes, a Total of $15,00 due 1 Dec, the row Add payment method and a greyed out Approve button. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method was needed, so the charge was not approved and it was cancelled. Nothing was billed and no card was entered. The Growth and Scale approval screens were not opened. Cancelling: no subscription was started, so nothing could be cancelled. The way to stop is to uninstall: Settings, Apps, Storista, Uninstall opens Uninstall Storista? with the text that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, a request to delete customer data within 48 hours and a required reason (Testing multiple apps). Not tested: a video import, a widget in the theme editor, the Shop app, auto-sync, AI tagging, the unlimited videos claim on Free, auto captions in any language, and any paid plan. No theme change was made or saved and no widget or page was created. Clean up: the app was uninstalled through Settings, Apps and is gone from the Installed list; no theme sections or pages were made by the app; no plan was approved and nothing was billed. Our own tabs were closed. The clock times in the notes (16:55 and 16:56) can be a few minutes off. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The core action could not be reached with our tools, the onboarding says maximum 10 videos for an upload while the free plan lists unlimited videos, the plan page says Auto captions 60 languages where the dossier says 40, the Starter approval screen asked for a payment method and had no test charge sentence, and the Instagram and TikTok sources need a username and a rights tick box before anything is imported.
